regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, keywords, and SI availability sentence
regions.finding: The source title and aggregate desulfitative-coupling claim were inspected. Although the article mentions online Supporting Information, workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
The sulfonylation and desulfination arrows are generic background reaction classes and are classified as one general-scheme record, not current-paper experiments.

The hydroarylation and substrate-controlled vinyl-sulfone/internal-alkyne reactions are explicitly cited previous work and are represented as literature examples rather than experiments of this article.
The propargylic-carbonate/sodium-sulfinate to allene arrow is the generic current-paper transformation; row-specific experiments appear in Tables 1–4 and controls.

unresolved: Generic R-group structures do not define unique molecules or experiment-specific yields.
Supporting Information is mentioned by the paper but is not associated in this workspace.

regions.region: page 2 left column ligand-screening prose and Table 1
regions.finding: Eight independent ligand-screening rows were retained with exact shared quantities, ligand identity/loading, 50 °C/19 h, product-specific NMR yields, source slash markers, 3/4/5 ratios, recoveries, no-product statements, and qualitative trace/quantitative values. Table 1 entry 6 is merged with identical Table 2 entry 1.
Narrative results were linked to the independent Table 2 optimization and Table 3/4 scope rows shown on page 3; no prose-only duplicates were created.
A distinct 1a/2a/[Pd(allyl)Cl]2 control at 60 °C for 48 h with no ligand gives no desired product and 96% recovery of 1a.
A distinct sulfone-6 control with [Pd(allyl)Cl]2/L6 in toluene at 60 °C for 11 h gives 0% 5aa and 79% recovery of 6.
The prose introduces proposed Pd intermediates continued on pages 3–4; they are represented as one mechanism record, not preparations.

unresolved: Most optimization rows omit workup, purification, isolated masses, atmosphere, and recovery measurement basis.
Scope structures beyond fully legible 1a/5aa remain label-based and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 2 entries 1–10 and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten parameter-optimization rows were reconciled. Entry 1 is identical to Table 1 entry 6 and merged; entries 2–10 remain independent with row catalyst/solvent/temperature/time, NMR yield, recovery, N2, and 1.05-equiv 2a overrides. Rows 2–6 retain a conflict between their row solvent and footnote-a's printed anhydrous toluene wording.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Table 3 entries 1–15 and footnotes
regions.finding: Fifteen independent carbonate-scope experiments were retained with shared isolated-yield conditions, doubled catalyst/ligand loadings for entries 4/5/6/8, and entry-6 21% recovery plus 14 uL CH2Br2 internal standard.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Table 4 entries 1–7 and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven independent carbonate/sulfinate scope experiments were retained with row-specific 48.7/66/54 h times, the 80 °C entry, 17% recovery plus 14 uL CH2Br2, and the 2.0-equiv 2c override.
Ligand exchange, desulfitation, reductive elimination, and catalyst regeneration complete the proposed mechanism text and do not create isolated intermediate records.

unresolved: The Table 2 row-solvent/shared-footnote wording conflict remains for entries 2–6.
Scope rows generally omit isolated masses and detailed workup/purification.
Complex scope structures remain label-only where a safe unique SMILES was not established.

regions.finding: The complete Pd0Ln→I→II→III→5aa cycle is a proposed mechanism. NaOMe and SO2 are displayed coproducts; I–III are not isolated experiments.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Figure 1 and biological-activity prose
regions.finding: A549 SRB growth-inhibition data and the 5ka IC50=28.27 uM are biological assay results, not chemical reaction records; no synthesis is created from this figure.

The exact 1a/2a/[Pd(allyl)Cl]2/L6/toluene charges, N2 atmosphere, 60 °C/48 h reaction, silica filtration, 13 mL ethyl acetate elution, concentration, and chromatography enrich Table 3 entry 1 rather than creating a duplicate.

Liu Qi is thanked for reproducing results for 5ha, 5oa, and 5ra. No independent run details are supplied, so provenance is linked to the existing Table 3 entry 10 and Table 4 entries 2/5 without duplicate experiments.
Bibliography/prior-literature context only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

The reproduction acknowledgment does not identify separable runs.
Biological assay details beyond the displayed Figure 1 values are outside the chemical-reaction record schema.
